versions.content: Realizes relationship of AUTOSAR elements The alloca- tion of safety requirements or safety measures may be expressed by a realizes reference. The reference shall be added as Sdg data to the AdminData section of the element with attribute gid=REALIZES . The XML contents shall contain an Sd element with a list of sdx references referring to the allocated safety requirements.
